approval.rationale: All functional and non-functional requirements aligned with master prompt.

functionalRequirements.title: Deterministic Lifecycle State Machine
functionalRequirements.description: Enforce sequential progression through gates G0 to G6 with explicit entry, exit, and approval checks.
functionalRequirements.userStory: As an orchestrator, I want deterministic gates so that agents cannot skip requirements or verification.

functionalRequirements.title: Anti-Slop Quality Policy Enforcement
functionalRequirements.description: Automatically detect and disallow decorative emojis, fake prod data, unimplemented stubs, and unexplained workarounds.
functionalRequirements.userStory: As a developer, I want anti-slop rules so that AI output meets rigorous engineering standards.

functionalRequirements.title: Git-Aware Memory Reconciliation
functionalRequirements.description: Reconcile project memory against actual git status and commits upon session startup to detect drift.
functionalRequirements.userStory: As an agent, I want git reconciliation so that I don't overwrite manual human edits.

functionalRequirements.title: Canonical Contracts & JSON Schema Validation
functionalRequirements.description: Define all project stages via versioned JSON Schemas with automated validation.
functionalRequirements.userStory: As an engineer, I want structured contracts so that handoffs between agents are unambiguous.

nonFunctionalRequirements.description: Core framework must execute on standard Python 3.10+ without mandatory third-party pip dependencies.
No plain-text credentials, tokens, or private source code leaked outside local repository.
All skills, instructions, and agents must follow standardized schema structures.

acceptanceCriteria.scenario: Agent attempts to transition from G1 to G4 skipping G2 and G3
Agent outputs code containing decorative emoji and 'TODO: implement later'
acceptanceCriteria.expectedOutcome: QualityEvaluator flags anti-slop violations and fails gate check.

acceptanceCriteria.scenario: Session starts with uncommitted modified files in git working tree
acceptanceCriteria.expectedOutcome: Memory reconciler detects uncommitted changes and halts or alerts before destructive action.

edgeCases.condition: Project is a backend-only CLI or library with no graphical UI
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Gate G2 (Design) can be formally exempted with documented justification.

edgeCases.condition: Independent reviewer rejects implementation at Gate G5
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: State machine transitions backward from G5 to G4 with review defects logged.
